headline: Budget Traps to Avoid When Hiring a Kitchen Remodeling Contractor
articleBody:
A kitchen remodel is one of the most rewarding investments you can make in your home, but vague estimates and rushed selections can push costs well past your expectations. Understanding where budgets break down helps you protect your investment.

### Common Mistakes to Avoid
Watch out for these six traps when comparing quotes and hiring your remodeling team:
- Ordering cabinets before framing verification: Cabinets ordered from rough plans often fail to fit if drywall or flooring shims alter finished dimensions. Always pull final measurements after demolition.
- Accepting vague material allowances: Generic allowances for countertops or appliances hide true costs. Specify exact models and materials before signing your agreement.
- Overlooking mechanical duct routing: Failing to map exhaust hood venting early often leads to expensive ceiling drops or exterior rerouting.
- Shifting plumbing on a slab or finished ceiling: Moving a sink across the kitchen sounds simple, but cutting concrete or drilling through support joists raises labor costs fast.
- Skipping delivery inspections: Storing cabinet boxes without checking for freight damage leads to work delays once installation begins.
- Starting demo before products arrive: Tearing out your old kitchen while custom cabinets face factory lead times leaves you without a functional kitchen far too long.
